checkNote: README: "若使用局域网 Ollama，确认 Zotero 所在机器能访问服务", and the embedding service can be on the local machine. The pack doesn't say whether any key is needed: a bundled Nomic ONNX model works, but there is no default prefs file and the MCP bearer token is generated by the plugin.
